summary.en: Sign PDFs yourself or ask others to sign, inside filex: named boxes on the page, a step-by-step screen for both sides, a receipt for every signer and a Verify report on any PDF.

caption.en: Requesting signatures: each named box is placed on the page
The boxes to fill in: who signs, how, and what is printed under the signature
An outside signer fills in the named boxes on a time-limited page
The file is held while signatures are collected; the details panel follows every signer
